results.title: DC directs safe arrangements, regulated manufacturing for Basant 2027
results.description: LAHORE - Deputy Commissioner Lahore Muhammad Ali Ejaz on Saturday chaired a review meeting at Jallo Park to finalize preparations for Basant 2027, directing the district administration to enforce strict regulatory monitoring to ensure public safety during the traditional festival.
